title: PERFECTION IN THE BOOK OF JAMES
theme: James describes God’s perfect gifts and law and the maturity expressed in patience, works, and restraint.
proposition: Christian maturity grows through God’s gifts and law, persevering patience, active faith, and control of speech.
sermonQuestion: How does James describe perfection in the Christian life?

THE PERFECT FAITH BY WORKS – JAMES 2:22
THE PERFECT MAN BY RESTRAINT – JAMES 3:2
